subsection.name: Introduction
subsection.p: This module proposes two different services to store the GRU notifications in the CRM plugin service :

ul.li: A simplified Rest service : Create or update in one call the CRM items : Notification, Demand, Customer.
A notifier service to store locally the notification in the CRM service (same site)

subsection.p: Rest service dedicated to GRU notifications, to create or update notification (and demand) in one call.
Rest service to list demand types

subsection.name: Configuration
subsection.p: Enable the Rest Service in the site properties (WEB-INF/conf/override/plugins/crm-notifygru.properties) :
Or enable the local notifier (if CRM is available in the same site than the notifygru library)
